page.layout: One column of text. Above it, a printed ornamental border, then a centred title block in capitals and spaced type, then the running text in italic. Printed page references "Pag. 1." and "Pag. 2." stand centred between paragraphs. The signature "* ij" stands at the lower right, below the text.

main_text.head: BENEDICTIONES S. D. N. PAPÆ SIXTI V. IN REGEM NAVARRVM ET PRINCIPEM CONDAEVM.

p.i: Exercemus arma militiæ nostræ contra duos iræ filios Henricū Borbonium,
QVONDAM Nauarræ regem, & Henricum item Borbonium OLIM Principem Condensem. Ille hæreses ab ineunte adolescentia secutus pertinax earum patrocinium exercuit.
Idem revolutus in cœno, caput, dux, & propugnator hæreticorum & perduellium, arma contra regem suum Christianissimum aduersus i-

page.notes: The title block is set in mixed capitals and small capitals; it is transcribed as one heading. The ornament above the title is not text and is left out. The mark after "Borbonium" and after "patrocinium" is a printed comma-like stroke, transcribed as a comma. "Henricū" carries a macron over the u as printed. "QVONDAM" is in small capitals in the scan. The first word "Idem" is printed with a capital-looking I in italic; it is read as the vowel I. The line "aduersus i-" ends in a printed hyphen and the word continues on the next page.
